question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
actual_sql:
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ym.consumption > 528.3)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_customers_above_threshold
FROM yearmonth ym
WHERE ym.date = '201202';
